Dear Customer,

Thank you for your email.

We understand that the vehicle was previously owned and that you are waiting to complete the binding/unbinding process in the iSMART App.

Normally, if a previous owner unbinding request has been submitted through the App, the process may take up to 72 hours. During this time, the App may not always show a waiting screen or send a separate email notification.

If the vehicle is still shown as bound after 72 hours, we can help check the binding status and assist with a forced unbinding request if needed. In that case, please provide the following information:

1. Country/Region
2. Vehicle brand and model
3. Full 17-character VIN
4. Your iSMART account email address or mobile number
5. Proof of vehicle ownership
6. Copy of your driving licence
7. Screenshot of the binding message shown in the App

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
iSMART Service Team

Dear Customer,
We sincerely apologize for the delayed response and understand your frustration.
According to our backend check, vehicle activation has not been completed. This may cause the message, “This service is not available at present. Please try later,” and prevent the QR code from being displayed for vehicle binding.
Please check that the date, time and time zone are correct on the infotainment screen, then complete vehicle activation through:
Settings > General > Activation > Activate
After activation, restart the infotainment system and try the binding process again.
If activation still fails, please provide a short video showing the complete activation process and any error message displayed on the vehicle screen.
Best regards,
iSMART Service Team
